catalogue-audit.barcode_validation_note: Identifier format only; GTIN checksums have not been validated. Duplicate barcode records remain separate and are ineligible for automatic exact-identity links.

commodity-audit.weekly_values_policy: Identical series/date/value duplicates counted once. Conflicting values for the same series/date are excluded from weekly aggregation; raw observations retained.

unit_review.icco: Official table headers are GBP sterling/tonne, US dollars/tonne and euros/tonne. No pence scaling or unit conversion performed. raw_unit preserves source labels.
unit_review.ecb: GBP and USD columns quote currency units per 1 EUR. USD per GBP = (USD per EUR)/(GBP per EUR). Original rates exported; no cross-rate or current-FX substitution performed.
unit_review.eu_world: Source workbook headings $/ton for cereal and $/t for oilseeds. Cereal unit retained as per_source_ton, unit_definition_status=unknown_ton_definition because a metric/short-ton definition was not independently established. Oilseed t is the source tonne symbol. No numeric mass/currency conversion performed. Source raw_unit preserved.
unit_review.eu_cereal: Vl Euro Price is euro/tonne. National price and currency remain in source_raw_json; normalized output uses the published euro price, without another FX conversion.
unit_review.identity: series IDs distinguish commodity, market, currency and stage. Different countries, quoted locations, stages and original currencies are never averaged into a common price.

retail_panel_overlap.note: Observation-date overlap only; does not establish historical availability or vintages.

commodity-audit.weekly_method: W-FRI Saturday-Friday: mean of real daily observations, or weekly quoted points. Native weekly source intervals are retained. No interpolation/filling; changes require adjacent weekly buckets.
commodity-audit.publication_times: available_at=NULL,publication_known=false,eligible_for_backtest=false until historical release/vintage policy is verified. ECB normal 16:00 CET schedule alone is not a row-specific timestamp.

monthly-audit.eligibility_rule: Adjacent calendar months; dataset spans both full months; at least 3 observed days per month and observations in first/last 7 days; same listing, price basis and dimension.
limitations: Sampled monthly medians do not imply daily continuous coverage.
January and April are partial dataset boundary months, excluded by default.

Same-barcode coverage is not cross-barcode family coverage.

reason: 39,920 eligible mass-price pairs cover 1 distinct target month(s). The minimum comparison policy requires three training target months and one later test target month. Splitting products from the same month would not test future calendar periods.
